summary: Linkage Global Inc filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Extraordinary General Meeting held September 8, 2026, at which shareholders approved a 23-for-1 reverse share split (share consolidation) effective September 18, 2026. All 998,000,000 Class A and 12,000,000 Class B ordinary shares of US$0.0025 par value consolidate into roughly 43.4 million Class A and 0.52 million Class B shares at US$0.0575 par, with fractional shares rounded up. A related special resolution adopts amended articles. No deal, price, premium, advisor, or recommendation is stated. Watch for post-split trading liquidity and any reverse-split-driven compliance or capital-raising motives.
